scope: Godot 4 plugins, editor tools, native extensions, AI-assisted creation, and companion workflows relevant to the 22 categories in the issue.

source_priority: Canonical upstream GitHub repository and release/tag pages
Official Godot documentation and official Asset Library
Secondary material only when no upstream statement was available
methodology.asset_library_note: The official Asset Library host did not resolve in the research environment. Its upstream backend repository says it is in maintenance mode and expected to be deprecated in favor of a future Godot Foundation asset store. Candidate-specific asset IDs/URLs are UNKNOWN unless directly verified; UNKNOWN does not mean absent.
methodology.compatibility_note: Godot 4.7.2 is the target. A 4.7, 4.6+, or broad Godot 4 claim is not treated as proof of 4.7.2 support. Findings are upstream declarations, not results of installation or testing.

godot_target_release.plugin_test_note: The release date establishes the target engine release only. No candidate is claimed to have a verified Godot 4.7.2 test unless its own entry says so.

methodology.release_date_note: Where retrieved upstream pages exposed a release/tag but not a date, the tag is preserved and the date is UNKNOWN. No date has been estimated.
methodology.unknown_convention: UNKNOWN means upstream evidence was absent, inaccessible, or not sufficiently specific. It is not a negative finding.

status_convention.CANDIDATE: Worth isolated, gated future evaluation; not selected, approved, installed, or production-ready.
status_convention.REFERENCE_ONLY: Useful for comparison or as an external workflow, not a proposed project dependency.
status_convention.REJECT: Available evidence shows a direct mismatch for the stated target/version.
status_convention.UNKNOWN: Evidence is inadequate to make a status recommendation.

methodology.non_mutation: No plugins/dependencies were installed, no engine/runtime/project settings were changed, and no remote service was signed up for.

supported_godot_versions.upstream_statement: Godot 4; README specifically notes UID operations for Godot 4.4+.
supported_godot_versions.godot_4_7_2: UNKNOWN; not explicitly declared or tested in retrieved upstream material.

candidates.implementation_language_and_dependencies: TypeScript/Node.js (README requires Node.js >=18 and npm) plus bundled GDScript operations; requires a Godot executable and an MCP-capable host.
candidates.editorplugin_vs_runtime_behavior: External MCP server, not an EditorPlugin or runtime addon. Starts Godot editor/projects and invokes editor/project operations.
candidates.android_export_viability: UNKNOWN; no Android-specific build/export validation found. It can launch a Godot project but that does not establish an Android export path.
candidates.headless_ci_viability: Partial: documented Godot CLI/project operations could fit automation, but no 4.7.2 headless CI certification found.
candidates.gl_compatibility_implications: UNKNOWN; server control does not establish project renderer compatibility.
candidates.installation_footprint: Node package via npx, or source build (`npm install`, build); local server process plus Godot executable. Exact transitive footprint not audited.
candidates.permissions_filesystem_mutation_scope: Targets a supplied Godot project path. Advertised operations include project inspection, scene creation, node insertion, sprite loading, scene save, UID update, editor/project launch and stop. Treat as having write access to project files and process-launch authority.
candidates.network_endpoints_telemetry_data_egress: npx/package installation contacts the package registry unless dependencies are preinstalled. MCP server/provider telemetry and other egress are UNKNOWN; the server README does not establish the MCP host's network behavior.
candidates.api_key_or_secret_requirements: No model credential is documented by the server. Cloud MCP host/model credentials or subscription may be required outside the server; provider-specific requirements are UNKNOWN.
candidates.local_model_support: No model is bundled. Local model support depends on the separate MCP client/host.
candidates.ollama_compatibility: UNKNOWN; server README documents MCP clients but no direct Ollama integration or tested Ollama host/model pairing.
candidates.cloud_model_providers: Not selected by the server; README names MCP clients including Claude Code, Cline and Cursor. Model provider is controlled by each client.
candidates.execute_commands_or_mutate_files_scenes: Yes for documented Godot/editor/project operations and process launch. General arbitrary shell execution is not documented and remains UNKNOWN. README example includes auto-approval configuration, which can remove human review for listed tools.
candidates.security_privacy_concerns: High privilege boundary: writes scenes/project resources, launches local processes, and exposes project/debug information to the host. Auto-approval is unsafe for mutations. Review tool schemas, constrain project root/process policy, pin package version, and use a disposable checkout.
candidates.reproducibility_offline_viability: A locally installed/built server may run without a model network connection, but npx bootstrap requires package availability unless cached. Host/model offline behavior is separate and UNKNOWN.
candidates.integration_complexity: Medium: Node runtime, MCP client configuration, Godot executable path, project permissions and approval policy.
candidates.luhm_status_reason: Its documented scene/file mutation and process-launch scope is too broad for adoption without a separately designed permission boundary and human-gated evaluation.

coverage_notes: All 22 categories are represented by the category index and categorized survey in the companion Markdown document. Built-in engine systems and external companion applications are explicitly distinguished from installable addons.

No AI-assisted tool was verified as a full autonomous author for all listed content types. Individual tools document different editor, script and resource operations; provider capabilities are separate.

Ollama Assistant documents local selected-script GDScript edits. Funplay, Godot AI MCP and Ivan Murzak MCP document distinct scene/script/resource operations; none has an explicit 4.7.2 test result here.
No direct Ollama/Godot MCP pairing was validated. Local-only operation is conditional on the selected host and its data path.
Cloud model credentials, providers, network egress and retention belong to the external assistant/provider, not the Godot MCP server.

The Asset Library host was inaccessible in the research environment. Debug Draw 3D's direct asset page is linked by its upstream README; additional AI catalog links are search-result leads only. Unverified details remain unknown, not negative claims.
Godot 4.7.2 support, Android viability, headless CI, GL Compatibility, binary ABI, security and offline behavior must be independently revalidated before T1/T2/T3 integration.
